Gorilla WWE 2K26 Mod Manager v1.0.0
- Manage WWE 2K26 CAK mods safely. - Organize mods into Main Game, Clean, Recording, and Mod Test Profiles. - View Profiles without activating them. - Turn individual Gorilla-managed mods ON or OFF. - Mark and restore a Last Working Profile. - Use Mod Doctor and Find a Problem Mod for guided troubleshooting. - Unmanaged mods stay untouched. - Mod changes pause while WWE 2K26 is running. - Includes a beginner-friendly User Guide and update checking.
Free tool by Gorilla Modding. Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/GorillaModding Discord: https://discord.gg/nAjKwVzRn
